legend.title: THE LEGEND OF SENET
legend.p1: Before the first stone was carved, Senet was played. It is not a mere pastime for the living, but a map of the soul's passage through the Duat. Each move is a footstep through the twilight, where the shadows of the past weigh against the light of the future.
legend.p2: Five pieces represent the fragments of a spirit, striving to reach the horizon beyond the trial. The board is the path of the sun's nocturnal voyage, a sacred geometry where fate is cast upon the sticks and destiny is woven by the hands of the gods.
legend.p3: To win is to transcend the cycle of rebirth and join the eternal stars. To lose is to remain in the shifting sands, waiting for another dawn to attempt the journey once more.

h26.title: House of Happiness

h27.title: House of Water
h27.desc: The Abyssal Void. A perilous trap where the unwary are swept back into the cycle of rebirth.

h28.title: House of Truth
h28.desc: The Hall of Ma'at. Here the spirit must stand firm, for only those of pure heart may move forward.

h29.title: House of Re-Atum

h30.title: House of Horus
h30.desc: The Final Threshold. Escaping with the blessing of Horus into the eternal afterlife.

guide.title: HOW TO PLAY
guide.objective: Navigate all five of your pieces off the board to secure your place in the afterlife.
guide.movement: Pieces follow a S-shaped path across three rows of ten squares.
guide.throwing: The throw of four sticks determines your movement (1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 squares). Throws of 1, 4, or 5 grant an extra turn.
guide.capturing: Land on an opponent’s isolated piece to swap positions with them.
guide.protection: Two adjacent pieces of the same color are protected and cannot be captured.
guide.blockades: Three or more adjacent pieces of the same color form an impassable barrier for the opponent.
guide.special: The final five houses hold sacred meanings and unique trials for every traveler.
guide.bearing_off: Pieces must land exactly beyond the final square with an exact throw to pass into eternity.
